title: PID controller lifecycle
api_protocol: init -> set gains -> updates -> get -> reset
functional_goals: Reset is idempotent on the controller object projection and preserves gains; getters expose the last command; update histories match the exact rounded controller recurrence. Effective integral clamping is distinguished from the stored sum field. Prove preservation over any finite input sequence.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Writable controller object, separation/frame assumptions; later bounded-output theorems need explicit numeric hypotheses. No stability theorem is assumed.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Low-pass filter lifecycle
functional_goals: Reset establishes the specified history; each step shifts history and computes the source-order rounded recurrence; any finite sequence agrees with iterating that transition.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Initialization may call target libm. Existing lowpass proofs require explicit transport to the new environment, not reuse by filename.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Kinematic state estimator
state: SimpleKinematicKalman state[6], P, Q, r, dt, Hp/Hs
api_protocol: init -> set state/noise -> predict -> update position/speed -> get state
functional_goals: Set/get round-trip preserves component bits under separated output memories. Prediction preserves velocity slots and updates each position by add32(p,mul32(v,dt)); prove its iterated recurrence. Correction obeys a separate gain/state transition.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Correction calls matrix-inversion support; its executable coverage/contract must be established before a complete predict-correct theorem. Symmetry or positive definiteness is not presumed bit-exact.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Lazy orientation representation cache
state: OrientationReps status and seven representation payloads
api_protocol: set -> cache-hit get, or get -> calculate -> cache valid
functional_goals: Setters invalidate other representations and preserve the new payload; cache-hit getters return the stored representation without modifying its object bytes; cache-miss paths establish the corresponding valid bit under conversion contracts. Induct over permitted API histories.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Bitwise round-trip equality between different orientation representations is not assumed. Conversion calls and permitted status/payload invariant remain explicit obligations.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Delayed bounded-increment filter
functional_goals: Configured delay is below 20; propagation preserves the circular index range and implements the exact integer recurrence and clamp. Compose this into a delayed-stream relation for arbitrary finite samples.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Signed arithmetic and shift/division conditions belong in the future proof precondition, not the execution model.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Attitude rate/acceleration saturation
functional_goals: State a bounded-rate and boundary-acceleration property for the implemented clamps; use it as a local invariant lemma in a later control-cycle proof.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Float NaN/range and integer overflow hypotheses must be stated for the particular property; no whole-autopilot pipeline is invented.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Framed byte FIFO
state: framed_ring_buffer offsets, backing bytes and frame lengths
functional_goals: Clear establishes empty state; accepted puts followed by gets preserve message order and exact payload bytes, including wraparound; valid frame layout bounds the drop_last traversal. Prove preservation over operation histories.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Actual memcpy/builtin interfaces, aliasing, capacity and valid frame layout must be discharged. A malformed buffer is not removed from the model.
status: aligned; functional goals proposed, no proofs attempted

title: Fixed-point navigation coordinates
state: Local origin, rotation matrix, ECEF/ENU/NED points and vectors
api_protocol: Define the local frame, transform ECEF coordinates, then convert ENU to NED.
functional_goals: Prove point conversion agrees with vector conversion of the displacement from the stored origin. Prove NED output is the ENU component permutation with the vertical sign reversed. Preserve the actual fixed-point shifts and casts.
remaining_proof_boundaries: State representability and memory separation conditions. Geodetic and trigonometric calls crossing translation units need corresponding contracts. A round trip needs a quantization bound.

title: Fixed-point trigonometry
api_protocol: Normalize and fold the angle, read the sine table, and derive cosine via a phase shift.
functional_goals: Prove normalization terminates on the selected range, lookup indices remain within the actual table, and the cosine entry agrees with the source phase shift followed by sine.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Bind the result to the default table configuration and actual integer operations. A real-valued accuracy theorem is a separate obligation.

title: Relative localization EKF
state: X, Xp, Zp, covariance matrices, Jacobians and workspaces
api_protocol: Initialize, predict the next state and measurement, and correct with the observed measurement.
functional_goals: First show the prediction agrees with the source-order rounded state and covariance recurrence and initializes the fields used by correction. Then compose prediction and correction over a finite observation history.
remaining_proof_boundaries: The correction calls float_mat_invert. Its execution or contract correspondence must be supplied. Keep the range measurement and powf/sqrtf behavior explicit.

title: Camera coordinate conversion
state: Intrinsics, distortion parameter and normalized/pixel coordinates
api_protocol: Convert pixels to normalized coordinates, apply the distortion operation, and project back into pixels.
functional_goals: Prove the two wrapper functions agree with the actual helper composition, including each rounded multiplication, subtraction, division and cast. State an error bound separately for round trips.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Specify nonzero focal lengths, valid square-root arguments when required and defined conversion ranges.

title: Magnetic field coefficient and evaluation pipeline
state: Coefficient arrays and magnetic field vector
api_protocol: Extrapolate coefficients for the requested date and pass that array to the field evaluator.
functional_goals: Prove the coefficient array is initialized over the harmonic index range used by evaluation. Compose the coefficient recurrence and field-evaluation recurrence with the mixed precision in the C implementation.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Bind supported harmonic degrees to the actual arrays. Supply target libm contracts and account for conversions between float and double.

title: No-north EKF initialization, measurement and correction
state: Relative state, heading, measurements and Jacobians
api_protocol: Initialize the state, evaluate the motion and measurement functions and their Jacobians, and apply correction to an initialized prediction state.
functional_goals: Prove the measurement projection preserves the bits of copied state components and computes range in source evaluation order. Specify correction against an explicit prediction-state relation.
remaining_proof_boundaries: The original predictor calls the VLA-based c2d helper. Its separate import limitation still applies. Matrix inversion and target libm remain proof boundaries.

title: Image memory and pyramid construction
state: Image descriptors, YUV422 bytes, grayscale buffers and allocated pyramid levels
api_protocol: Create or receive an image, convert it to grayscale, pad the border, and construct successive levels.
functional_goals: Prove grayscale extraction reads the luminance bytes and preserves the specified metadata. Prove border padding and each pyramid level agree with the implemented index and shift recurrences, then compose across levels.
remaining_proof_boundaries: Specify allocation, memory copying, image layout and nonaliasing. The uint8 level counter needs a representable exit value. Prove the in-place vertical pass in execution order.

title: Lucas-Kanade optical flow
state: Image levels, feature coordinates and per-feature displacement
api_protocol: Build image pyramids, extract windows, compute gradients, and update feature displacement.
functional_goals: Relate accepted features and returned displacements to the bounded, rounded update recurrence and the actual out-of-range rejection paths.
remaining_proof_boundaries: When image.c is included by the align driver, the pyramid and window helpers execute inside the shared model. Transfer to the production build requires linkage and configuration correspondence.
